title: Halting after checking a suffix length
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. For every decomposition $x=uv$ and every natural number $r$ with $r\le |c.output|$, the augmented machine started from the configuration determined by $c$, $u$, and $r$, in its state numbered $3$, halts within at most $|v|+1$ steps and has output consisting of the single Boolean value that is true exactly when $|v|\le r$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
